name: toe yoga
description: Lifting the big toe while the other toes stay down, then the other way round. It teaches the big toe and the small toes to move separately.
instructions: Sit or stand with your bare feet flat on the floor.
Lift the big toe while pressing the four smaller toes into the floor.
Lower it, then press the big toe down and lift the four smaller toes.
Return all five toes to the floor. The heel and the ball of the foot stay still, only the toes move.
If a toe will not move yet, hold the others down with your hand at first.
